worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.summary: Three swords rise around the user and close as the dance grants Attack. Dance in place or advance slowly; an interruption before the closing beat prevents this new boost.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.use.0: Prepare physical attacks during an opening
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.use.2: Choose between further preparation and attacking now
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.descriptio: Complete the %2$s dance to gain up to %1$s Attack stages. An interruption before the closing beat prevents this new boost. The dance itself deals no damage.
The boost lasts %1$s. Expiry or dispelling removes only the Attack stages contributed by this dance.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.press.on: Advance up to %1$s blocks along the heading chosen at the start. Obstacles stop the advance while the dance can finish in place; the dance and cooldown take longer.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.press.off: Complete the quicker dance in place.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.growth.0: At level %1$s the hone stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.growth.1: At level %1$s the hone stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.preference: On: advance along the starting heading with a longer dance and cooldown. Off: finish in place.
The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means starting the hone earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.descriptio: Dancing again within the window keeps stacking Attack, up to a total of 6 stages.
It holds its ground and cannot move during the wind-up and recovery.
